rows.stateAndGrowth: One observed payload+one final decision; max2 facts naturally; source revision series produces separate owners.
rows.contention: Per source revision only.
rows.events: Observed source and accepted/dismissed reconciliation are business evidence decisions. Negative dismissal establishes owned disposition; not technical rejection receipt. Payloads often repeat tenant/subject/actor/timestamps already partly present in Portia metadata; rule16 wording is truncated, so no blanket rule16 violation is assigned. Discriminator attributes inspected; no rename is proposed while rule18 clarification is pending.
rows.crossOwner: Handler supplies canonical target revision/facts value. AcceptedForCurrentRevision becomes false if canonical changes; the observation does not enforce other owner forever.
rows.decisionStatus: retained boundary; implementation findings remain
